entities.title: The Worker
entities.summary: The Cloudflare Worker at cyberspace-explorer.com: it serves the page, signs readers in with GitHub and reads GitHub for them.
entities.purpose: Lets a reader read private GitHub repositories in the page without the page ever holding their GitHub access: the token stays in a sealed, HttpOnly cookie and only this code adds it to GitHub calls.
boundaries: The page itself is ../index.html, imported as text by index.js; this folder only serves it.
It reads GitHub and nothing else, and only the paths the page needs. GitLab, and readers who paste a token, never go through it.
Without its three secrets /auth/me says sign-in isn't set up and starting a sign-in answers 503; the page then falls back to pasted tokens.
No dependencies: app.js runs in Workers and in Node, which is how test/app.test.js runs it.
